ownerStatement: Ja, Filip, kao owner Lumen beta testiranja i provider/XUI pristupa, potvrđujem da je isti account/upstream dozvoljen za kontrolisani beta test do 300-500 korisnika. Potvrđujem da beta ne sme koristiti XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS workaround bez moje eksplicitne odluke. U slučaju 401/403/429/5xx eskalacije, playback regresije ili provider overload-a, ja sam decision owner za stop/throttle/rollback.

target.rolloutModel: Controlled beta ramp with explicit stop/throttle points before expanding to 300-500 live users.

observability.alertChannel: Manual beta escalation channel agreed by Filip; private Telegram/Discord/email endpoint is not stored in release artifacts.
observability.dashboardRef: Daily beta report or sanitized log export until a dedicated dashboard exists.

signals.name: Startup success/failure and time-to-first-frame
signals.source: web playback observability and provider preflight reports
signals.slo: 30 minutes for beta blocker response; stop enrollment if startup p95/p99 or startup failure burst breaches owner-approved threshold during a ramp step.
signals.stopTrigger: Stop new users on startup SLO breach or startup failure burst during the beta ramp.

signals.name: Playback errors and user problem reports
signals.slo: 30 minutes for beta blocker response; playback.error burst is a stop/throttle trigger.
signals.stopTrigger: Stop enrollment or roll back if playback failure burst threshold is breached.

signals.name: Provider auth/catalog/live-stream errors
signals.source: provider preflight, QA network report, and provider HTTP status breakdown
signals.slo: 30 minutes for beta blocker response; zero tolerance for sustained 401/403/429/5xx escalation that blocks playback.
signals.stopTrigger: Stop new users on provider 429/5xx burst, live-stream 401/403 escalation, or provider overload.

signals.name: Cast and AirPlay route failures
signals.source: cast.error, alert.cast-error-burst, manual device QA reports
signals.slo: 30 minutes for beta blocker response when Cast remains in scope; unsupported MP2 live sources must be blocked or warned instead of marked as Cast-supported audio.
signals.stopTrigger: Stop or narrow beta if Cast/AirPlay release-blocker checks fail on supported targets.

signals.name: No transcode/remux/ffmpeg policy violation
signals.source: runtime media policy, network HAR, process checks, provider/XUI owner evidence
signals.slo: Zero tolerated violations: any media-processing workaround is a beta stop condition.
signals.stopTrigger: Immediate stop if any ffmpeg, ffprobe, transcode, remux, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, generated HLS, or XUI-side media processing is observed.

observability.notes: Minimal beta ops setup is defined for controlled beta: Filip owner, manual alert route, daily beta report/log export while no dashboard exists, 30-minute blocker response SLO, and stop/throttle rules.

rollbackThrottle.notificationChannel: Manual beta escalation channel agreed by Filip; private Telegram/Discord/email endpoint is not stored in release artifacts.
rollbackThrottle.decisionAuthority: Filip is the decision owner for stop, throttle, rollback, and any explicit exception to the no-transcode/no-remux policy.
triggers: Provider overload, 429/5xx escalation, auth failure, live-stream 403/401 escalation, startup SLO breach, playback failure burst, Cast/AirPlay release-blocker regression, PWA install/offline release-blocker regression, or any ffmpeg/ffprobe/transcode/remux/proxy-remuxed/remux-hls/generated HLS/xui-side media processing violation.
throttleSteps: Stop new beta enrollment immediately after a stop trigger is confirmed.
Keep existing users at the current cohort size until owner decision.
Reduce or pause the cohort before adding additional users if provider or playback SLOs remain out of threshold.
rollbackSteps: Revert or redeploy the last known good build if Lumen introduced the regression.
Keep catch-up failures on provider-direct/proxy-normalized playback or unsupported overlay; do not enable transcode/remux workaround.
Re-run provider preflight, manual-device QA affected slices, runtime media policy validation, and no-media-processing audit before resuming enrollment.
verificationChecks: Runtime media policy validates and no forbidden media-processing processes are observed.
Affected manual-device QA targets have no release-blocker failures.
Capacity and readiness artifacts remain non-final until owner evidence is updated.
rollbackThrottle.notes: Rollback plan: return to the previous known-good build/SHA or pause rollout. Do not introduce transcode/remux/generated-HLS/XUI-side workaround without Filip's explicit decision.

checks.description: Named owner approves beta SLOs for startup, playback, provider errors, cast/airplay, and no-media-processing violations.
Alert channel, dashboard, and response path are defined before beta enrollment.
checks.evidence: observability.alertChannel and observability.dashboardRef in this artifact

checks.description: Rollback owner and decision authority are named with a maximum decision time.
checks.evidence: rollbackThrottle.owner, notificationChannel, decisionAuthority, and maxDecisionMinutes in this artifact

checks.description: Enrollment throttle path is approved for provider overload, playback regressions, or capacity breach.
checks.evidence: rollbackThrottle.triggers and throttleSteps in this artifact

checks.description: Any local ffmpeg, server-side transcode/remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed/remux-hls, or XUI-side media processing is a beta stop trigger.

signoff.notes: Filip owns beta ops, alert routing, daily report/log-export review, 30-minute blocker response, stop/throttle, rollback, and no-media-processing policy decisions for controlled beta.
